mustFix.problem: No photographs: every media slot is a placeholder-*.webp gradient; the approved autotuneup library holds only placeholders
mustFix.fix: Curate real approved autotuneup media in the niche media stage, re-map hero-A1 / process-* / place-* slots and rebuild

mustFix.problem: 8 alts read 'Placeholder for hero-A1' etc. and 7 describe photos that are not shown (WCAG 1.1.1)
mustFix.fix: Set alt="" on placeholder frames while they stay decorative; restore descriptive alts only when real photos are placed

elevate.move: Once real frames exist, make them the laps themselves: one tight process crop per station (keys, drain plug, old vs new filter, tread gauge, hand-back ticket) in one warm bay-light grade, revealed by the same sweep as the dial hand, with the hero a single letterboxed bay frame the stopwatch sits on.

Make the signature accessible by design: a polite live text equivalent for the dial ('Lap 3 of 6, filters, 24 minutes in'), a designed 3px deep-teal focus ring holding 3:1 on the tangerine band, and the planner ticket as an aria-live lap list, so the clock works by ear and keyboard.
